subject: Kickoff: Onboarding cadence & roles — Redwood x Lumen Health
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Onboarding cadence & roles — Redwood x Lumen Health

Hi Marta — great to meet you on the call this morning. As promised, I wanted to put a short note with proposed next steps so we can lock the mutual action plan and get the implementation cadence in your calendar.

High level ask: confirm owners & availability for the first three sprints so we can publish a weekly runbook and milestone tracker.

Proposed kickoff cadence (week 1 through go-live):
- Week 1: Kickoff + discovery (business objectives, success criteria, data access) — 1 hour
- Week 2: Integration setup + sample ingestion — 2x 90m sessions (infra + security)
- Week 3: Model tuning + acceptance criteria validation — 3 half-day workshops
- Week 4–6: Iterative acceptance, UAT, performance tuning, go/no-go decision

Owners (suggested):
- Redwood: Jasmine Liu (Customer Lead), Vivek Kulkarni (Solutions/Runtime), Monica Patel (Customer Success Engineer)
- Lumen Health: Marta Alvarez (Product Lead), Pedro Gomez (Platform PM)

Attachments: I’ve attached a draft MAP (Redwood-Lumen_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a simple sequence diagram for the integration points. Please review and reply with any calendar conflicts or additional stakeholders to loop in.

If that looks good, I’ll ask Monica to propose specific meeting slots for Weeks 1–3 and publish a shared checklist (weekly owner, artifact due, acceptance gate).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
From: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@lumenhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pedro Gomez <pedro.gomez@lumenhealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 11:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Onboarding cadence & roles — Redwood x Lumen Health

Thanks Jasmine — the proposed cadence looks sensible. A couple quick notes from our side:
- We need to include our security lead (Anjali Rao) on the Week 2 sessions for the data access discussion; she may join as a delegate.
- Pedro can own the platform-side tasks; I’ll own product acceptance and UAT.

Two scheduling asks:
1) Can we shift Week 1 kickoff to 3/8 (Monday) afternoon? Our team has an all-hands on 3/5.
2) For the Week 3 tuning workshops, mornings are better for our engineers (10:00–13:00 PT).

We reviewed the attached MAP quickly — looks like a good starting point. I’ll take a pass with Pedro and send redlines by Monday COB.

Best,
Marta
VP Product | Lumen Health
marta.alvarez@lumenhealth.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@lumenhealth.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 08:34:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Onboarding cadence & roles — Redwood x Lumen Health

Thanks Marta — confirmed on our side for 3/8 kickoff in the afternoon. I’m including a quick technical milestone breakdown so we have clear owners and acceptance criteria prior to the kickoff:

Technical milestones (owner — acceptance):
- Infra & Network Allowlist (Monica Patel) — acceptance: successful HTTPS handshake + test upload of 1GB sample within customer VPC/peered environment
- API keys & Token Rotation (Redwood infra team, contact: vivek_kulkarni) — acceptance: ability to rotate keys and observe token-level logs in the console
- Sample Ingestion Pipeline (Monica Patel) — acceptance: 10k records processed with no parse errors and <200ms per-record latency in test harness
- Model Variant Smoke Tests (Vivek Kulkarni) — acceptance: <150ms p50 gen latency on 128-token baseline, pass quality spot-checks against provided guidebook

Proposed artifacts to bring to Week 1 kickoff:
- Updated MAP (we’ll incorporate customer redlines)
- Network diagram (I attached implementation-sequence-diagram.png)
- Sample data schema + minimal ingestion script (Monica will provide link)

Monica — can you propose two 90m slots on 3/9 and 3/10 for the Week 2 integration sessions (security + infra)? I will escalate any gating issues early.

Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

On Mon, 8 Mar 2027 at 08:34, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I can do 3/9 09:30 or 3/10 11:00 PT — sending invites now.
> 
> Monica
> CSE | Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@lumenhealth.com>, Pedro Gomez <pedro.gomez@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP & weekly rhythm — action items for kickoff (3/8 recap)

Hi all — thanks for the quick turn. I’ve incorporated Marta’s notes and Pedro’s platform ownership into the attached MAP (Redwood-Lumen_MAP_v1.xlsx). Key updates:

- Kickoff moved to 3/8 15:00 PT (recap of attendees in calendar invite)
- Security lead Anjali is added to Week 2 sessions; Monica will share a pre-read for data access steps 48 hours in advance
- Week 3 tuning workshops set to mornings (10:00–13:00 PT) per Lumen preference

Immediate action items (owners & due dates):
1) Lumen: Provide sample data export (CSV) — owner: Pedro — due: 2027-03-12 COB
2) Redwood: Share ingestion script + test harness — owner: Monica — due: 2027-03-10 EOD
3) Redwood: Network allowlist document — owner: Vivek — due: 2027-03-09 EOD
4) Lumen: Confirm security contact + SOC requirements doc — owner: Marta — due: 2027-03-11

We’ll track these in the MAP and publish weekly status updates each Friday. Laura, I’ve looped you in to take point on overall post-kickoff CS coordination and renewal milestones. Please add anything I missed.

Thanks — see you in the kickoff.

—
Jasmine
From: Pedro Gomez <pedro.gomez@lumenhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP & weekly rhythm — action items for kickoff (3/8 recap)

All good from our side — confirmed Pedro will own the sample export and I’ll get the SOC requirements doc to Marta today so she can forward.

Quick note: if the ingestion script expects a parquet input, we’ll convert on our side; otherwise we’ll deliver CSV. Prefer to avoid extra transform steps on your side.

See you at kickoff.

—
Pedro
Platform PM | Lumen Health
pedro.gomez@lumenhealth.com
